data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open Planned Work, type the route in Search Routes, select it, optionally pick a date) with the right route and date parameters; it is slightly generic, calling the route "subway/bus" and not giving a link or selector for the date picker, but a browser automation could be built from it.
